examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.note: меня = me (genitive/accusative), мне = to me (dative)

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
meanings.note: Case forms. Core Russian pron meaning 'I' in everyday speech.
Usually plural ягоды = berries.

examples.text: Я взял чилийское вино и ягоды.
examples.trans: I brought Chilean wine and berries.

examples.text: Смотри, это электрогитара для Лёши. А тебе я взял чилийское вино и ягоды.
examples.trans: Look, this is an electric guitar for Lyosha. And for you I brought Chilean wine and berries.
